en_title: Xbox 'Business Strategist' Claims Video Game Industry Is 'Pretending to Not Use AI,' Deletes Twitter Account After Deluge of Replies
subtitle: 「不再假装」之后
opus_summary: XBOX策略师称游戏业假装不用AI，自己三小时就用AI做出了小游戏，并称数百名同事也在使用。言论引来大量回应，XBOX消息人士称他随后停用了X账号。

paragraphs.en: An Xbox staff member went viral this week for taking to social media to tell "the truth that nobody wants you to know": that the video game industry is "pretending" to not use AI.
paragraphs.cn: 一名XBOX员工本周在社交媒体上走红，因为他公开了「没人想让你知道的真相」：游戏行业正在「假装」不用AI。

paragraphs.en: Xbox Business Strategist, Brandon Stirrup, tweeted to say he'd used AI to create a "little bad game" after just three hours of work. He then used that as a springboard to talk about AI in gaming, and how the technology is more widely used than the industry lets on.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX商业策略师Brandon Stirrup发帖称，他只花了三个小时，就用AI做出了一款「糟糕的小游戏」。他随后以此为切入点，谈起AI在游戏领域的应用，称这项技术的实际使用范围比行业公开承认的更广。

paragraphs.en: In his posts, which have been preserved on Reddit, Stirrup insisted that "gaming is the only industry pretending not to use AI," and, "If you're a game developer refusing to believe that AI has a place in your future, you should not be in the business of being a business."
paragraphs.cn: 这些帖子已被保存在Reddit上。Stirrup在帖文中坚称，「游戏业是唯一还在假装不用AI的行业」，并表示：「如果你是游戏开发者，却拒绝相信AI会在你的未来占有一席之地，那你就不该做生意。」

paragraphs.en: Stirrup added: "Look if I'm fired tomorrow it will be because I told you the truth that nobody wants you to know. You can make a game with a simple prompt and yes you can make custom, tailored games. Everything you want in a game is right there for the taking, for better or worse.
paragraphs.cn: Stirrup补充道：「听着，如果我明天被解雇，那就是因为我告诉了你们没人想让你们知道的真相。只需一句简单的提示词，你就能做出一款游戏，没错，你也能制作量身定制的游戏。不管是好是坏，你想在游戏里拥有的一切都已经唾手可得。」

paragraphs.en: "I'm happy to take the hit if it means hundreds at Xbox can stop pretending that they're not using AI. It's time to accept and move forward."
paragraphs.cn: 「如果能让XBOX数百名员工不再假装自己没用AI，我很乐意为此承受冲击。是时候接受现实，继续向前了。」

paragraphs.en: "I love Xbox and Microsoft and I have spent 10+ years proving this," he added. "My goal is to get this over with so we can move on as a company, despite the fact that some will persecute me for this: we use AI, just as all companies do in 2026."
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「我热爱XBOX和微软，过去十多年里，我一直在用行动证明这一点。我的目标是让这件事告一段落，让公司能够继续前进，尽管有些人会因此迫害我：我们在用AI，就像2026年的所有公司一样。」

paragraphs.en: The comments sparked a flood of responses on social media, which a source at Xbox indicated led to Stirrup disabling his X / Twitter account.
paragraphs.cn: 这些言论在社交媒体上引来大量回应。一名XBOX消息人士表示，Stirrup因此停用了自己的X账号。

paragraphs.en: AI is the hottest topic in the industry. Fortnite developer Epic Games has already declared that code for its upcoming Star Wars shooter is going to be entirely written by AI, with the game director even declaring "no handwritten code" for the game. Epic boss Tim Sweeney has spent much of the last week trumpeting AI on social media, even as some hit out at the company's plans and its "vibe-coded" Epic Games launcher .
paragraphs.cn: AI是行业内最热门的话题。《堡垒之夜》开发商Epic Games已经宣布，旗下即将推出的《星球大战》射击游戏将完全由AI编写代码，游戏总监甚至宣称该作「没有手写代码」。过去一周的大部分时间里，Epic负责人Tim Sweeney都在社交媒体上大力鼓吹AI，尽管有人抨击公司的计划，以及通过「氛围编程」开发的Epic Games启动器。

paragraphs.en: Capcom also had a presentation recently where it presented 'REX' as a way to help the RE engine continue to mature, using, you guessed it, AI. However, the Resident Evil developer subsequently clarified that it would just be integrating AI tools to boost "the efficiency and productivity of the game development process," rather than using generative AI to create assets and code wholesale.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空最近也在一场演示中介绍了「REX」，以此帮助RE引擎继续完善，而它用到的技术——你猜对了——也是AI。不过，这家《生化危机》开发商随后澄清，公司只会整合AI工具，以提升「游戏开发过程的效率和生产力」，而不是用生成式AI大规模制作素材和编写代码。

paragraphs.en: AI is also being increasingly used for decompilation and modding. There's been an entire wave of AI-assisted mashup mods on X / Twitter that continues to gain traction. Plus, AI has become such a big part of the decomp scene that it's forced at least one community focused on manual decompilation to go offline . Microsoft has responded to this wave of AI in the modding community by launching Xbox Labs , which aims to do a lot of the same things that the community is already doing, including porting games to browsers.
paragraphs.cn: AI也越来越多地用于反编译和模组制作。X上涌现出一批借助AI制作的混搭模组，而且仍在不断受到关注。此外，AI在反编译圈中的影响已经大到迫使至少一个专注手动反编译的社区关闭。面对模组社区这股AI浪潮，微软推出了XBOX Labs，打算开展许多社区已经在做的工作，包括将游戏移植到浏览器。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps more impactful — or damaging, if you're in the business of selling video game consoles — is the role of AI in jailbreaking hardware. Sony is currently facing the possibility of a PS5 jailbreak on the eve of the launch of GTA 6, which could, theoretically at least, open the door to people making Rockstar's game available on PC. Rockstar parent company Take-Two would likely take a dim view of the PS5's encryption if that were to happen.
paragraphs.cn: AI在硬件越狱中的作用或许影响更大——如果你做的是游戏主机生意，那或许该说危害更大。索尼目前面临着PS5可能在《GTA6》发售前夕遭到越狱的局面，至少从理论上说，这可能让人有机会将Rockstar的这款游戏搬到PC上。如果真发生这种事，Rockstar的母公司Take-Two恐怕不会对PS5的加密措施有什么好评价。

paragraphs.en: As for Stirrup's claims, the only aspect of AI that game developers have meaningfully distanced themselves from by large is art and asset generation. As AI tools continue to mature, they're only going to be used in games more often. Heck, even Epic's Unreal Engine, which is used in every other game these days, has generative AI tools built into the UI . So, if this is the state of AI in gaming when developers are "pretending" to not use it, what will it look like when these companies stop "pretending?"
paragraphs.cn: 至于Stirrup的说法，总体来看，游戏开发者真正普遍与之保持距离的AI应用，只有美术和素材生成。随着AI工具不断成熟，它们在游戏中的使用只会更加频繁。要知道，如今几乎每隔一款游戏就会用到Epic的Unreal Engine，就连这款引擎也在用户界面中内置了生成式AI工具。那么，如果开发者还在「假装」不用AI时，游戏业就已经是这般景象，等这些公司不再「假装」时，又会是什么样呢？
